nom: StriVectin Advanced Retinol Nightly Multi-Correct Serum

avis.texte: I have used this advanced retinal nightly multi correct serum for years. Nobody can tell my age. My brother-in-law though I was at least 10years younger.
This is a fantastic product. I use it nightly and I think that I took about five years of aging off of my face.

I started using the nightly multi correct serum a year ago and definitely see a difference. My skin always looks fresh and smooth. It has a very light fragrance but nothing that is overbearing. Sometimes I forget to put moisturizer on top because it feels great. Does not have that taut feeling.

I like this retinol/retinal serum, because it delivers excellent results while being kind to skin. The consistency is such that it goes on smoothly without having to rub too much. I get many compliments on my skin. Have used this and other StriVectiin products for years. Nice (minimal) fragrance which I like. I do wish the company would work on the spring in the pump. It sticks just a little, so I guard the output with my hand as I pump.
This product works so well!!! And doesn't irritate my skin at all. I love it so much and can tell a big difference
Pump failed when only half empty. They replaced it but results still nothing to rave about.

The container looks huge, like it's going to be alot. It is not the size of that huge container. There must be a smaller tube inside. Either way it worked great. I used it all. My skin was brighter but I didn't see a huge difference in forehead wrinkles. You probably have to use it longer. I love stri vectin products
Works so well to keep my skin hydrated and wrinkles will lessen in a few weeks Helps ro keep my skin looking young and supple

I got the sample for free but after using it for 2 weeks and experiencing the "Retinol Purge", my skin has never looked better. I plan to use this for a very long time. Will definitely be getting more!

avis.titre: The only Retinol product I use
avis.texte: I started using this serum recently. I am generally not a fan of Strivectin's retinol products - I do not find them effective - but this one seems to do a good job.

I tested this product in the store today, on my face and neck ( the pump was clogged and squirt extra). The weird fragrance-less smell was too much and convinced me not to buy it but think I'm a super sniffer. Had to wash it off after getting home.
I think the product is helping with deep lines, generally I like StriVectin products but the packaging is a non-recyclable nightmare, causing me to rethink purchasing again

Great serum with just the right consistency to go on smoothly. Little to no fragrance noticed. Feels good on the skin. Haven't used it long, so it's a bit early to determine results. Have used StriVectin products nightly for many years, and their products do not irritate my skin like many retinol products have done.

Have only used nightly for about 2 weeks. I like the product. Easy to apply and spread on the skin with fingers. Very light, unnoticeable fragrance. The pump on my bottle sticks and splurts the serum out, so I have to guard it with my hand. Trying to determine if I like this or the Advanced Retinol Nightly Renewal Moisturizer better.
Love this product it makes my skin feel so much smoother and brighter

I was using a retinol purchased from dermatologist. After reading reviews on this product I swapped. My skin looks refreshed while pore size and fine wrinkles have diminished. 49 going on 50 and looking much younger thanks to this product and Strivectin.
Great product, started to see results after 3+ months of use. Noticed big improvement around the mouth lines.
I have been using your products twice daily for 20 years and at 83 I look 65. People are always surprised when I tell them my age.

avis.titre: Excellent Addition to my Evening Routine
avis.texte: Awesome product! Silky smooth, very little scent and a little goes a long way!
Love it! Much better than store-bought brands. Love that it's cruelty free.

Having mature skin I like using most of the Strivectin products. I did have a prescription for retinol but stopped using it and use Advanced Retinol Nightly Multi-correct serum instead. I feel it works just as well.
I can't believe the difference Advanced Retinol Nightly Multi-Correct Serum has made in my skins appearance. It was my first StriVectin product and still my favorite.

This serum is user friendly. Every night use doesn't irritate my skin. It seems as though it's been effective in smoothing and shortening stubborn wrinkles. I have been following the serum with the retinol moisturizer at night and using the vitamin C retinol serum in the morning.
I thought the morning retinol was terrific, but this nightly really adds on to do the job...
The Advanced Retunol Nightly Multi-Correct Serum is the finest night cream I have ever used. I can see a difference in the am! The cream does not irritate my skin. Extremely happy with the cream
I have a deep lines right in the middle of eyebrow, after using this product for almost a month, the lines are fading 70%, really recommend this product.

I love this retinol serum. Goes on your skin and sinks right in. The next morning skin feels smooth, and looks amazing. I have been using Strivectin for a few years now and love all their products. They work.
Have used Strivectin daily morning and evening for 5+ years and will continue. Strivectin leaves my face feeling moisturized and youthful.
I've been using this serum for several years now, and am so impressed with the results. I seem to have slowed down the aging process of my face and neck.
I just recently oped this product, so can't honestly comment on its effectiveness!
Love this moisturizer. I had very dry skin. I started using this moisturizer daily and my skin has never felt better!
I've used this brand for at least 5 years, never disappointed.
In just a week, I have noticed a difference in my skin. I live Strivectin!

I have been using this every night for 3-4 weeks and I do like it , but I haven't seen the results I was hoping for with this. I am thinking of getting the retinol moisturizer to go with it and see if that helps. It's not a bad product but there are others I like more. As far as a retinol goes it is not drying so that's a plus.

avis.titre: This is just one of my favorite night time products.
avis.texte: I use so many of the Strivectin products because I like to change it up...This is especially soothing to the skin I have seen a difference in the quality of my skin...I think all the strivectin products contribute to the positive effects!
Great moisturizer!!! Am loving the texture and it quickly absorbs after application. Will be adding this into my daily routine.
I love this Retinol! Historically, I could never use retinol because it was too harsh on my skin. This product I have been using nightly with no irritation and noticing wonderful differences!
Have been using for just a few weeks. Loving the results. I'm a 65 year old who thought my good skin days were gone, was I ever wrong. Brown spots are fading and so much softer. Thank you Strivectin.
This serum erased the age spots and spider veins on my cheeks! Amazing stuff!

I just started using this and my face looks clearer and the the tone is more even when I wash my face in the morning. It is easy to use and doesn't feel greasy- which is great when going to bed. I highly recommend this for anyone struggling with uneven skin tone or aging skin.
Been using for two weeks and see a dramatic improvement in lines around mouth and the "eleven" lines between brows. Definitely recommend

Purchase all of the products recommended, however, my skin is not responding to the products as I hoped, my skin is irritated, dry, and red around the nose, mouth area. I have stopped using it at this time. Once my skin heals, I will try it again. If it happens again then I will know for sure it this product brand.

I am really loving the retinol serum . It goes on so smooth and does not burn like most do. My skin appears to look more even tone and feels soft. I will continue to use this in my night routine .I've already lined up my next order. Thank you
I love this serum. My skin's texture and firmness is greatly improved after using it religiously every night. I deeply regret not starting a Strivectin skincare regime earlier in my life.

I Have tried other serums for what I say are small patches of light brown on my face. I really had the belief that they just don't work. I gave these retinol serums creams plumbers a try. Holy Cow! that serum Does Work! I've only used for I say 2 weeks tops. I'm using all the retinol.. the super c multi action retinol as well. How they work and dont cause a bit of irritation is amazing. Dont hesitate to purchase!

An excellent skin care that I use every single night, kept my skin soft, smooth and minimizes the lines! I use the entire retinol skin care at night and use the tightening product during the day! Highly recommended!

I use this as part of my nightly routine. This is a great addition that compliments the other nightly Strivectin products. I have seen a dramatic decrease in my middle-aged breakouts and my acne scars are less visible!
I use it regularly. I have a Stri-Vectin regime that the Multi-correct serum is a part of nightly.

avis.titre: It is totally the best product I have ever tried. Really ...
avis.texte: It is totally the best product I have ever tried. Really works. Takes years off.
Fights lines and wrinkles, but it's lightweight and absorbs quickly.
I love Strivectin products and believe they have provided visible results!
I love strivectin products. No matter what I use I am always happy with it and the amazing results.
Love this skin care products, fast absorbing, not oily, I used it every night. My skin looks like 10 years younger than my actual age of 70. Highly recommended!
Started using this product two weeks ago and love the feel on my skin. Absorbs quickly and you only need a little each night. This item will definitely be a reorder.
I wear this serum every night to replace old, wrinkled skin with bright, tightened skin cells. It doesn't cause irritation as a prescription might, and I enjoy a freshened face every morning.
I just made my second purchase of the nightly serum and I love it. I could tell a difference within the first few days of using and it has continuously gotten better. Worth every dime.
I started using this about a month ago and I haven't been disappointed. A little goes a long way and is effective yet gentle on my skin
This product is AMAZING! I saw immediate results in minutes. Perfect use for after a swim and before a night out!
My skin looks noticeably smoother! I had been using the retinol night cream but adding this was a game changer
This along with the nightly moisturizer have helped improve the look of my skin.

avis.titre: Must have for 40 year old skin
avis.texte: I couldn't imagine my nighttime routine without this cream. My 40 year old skin has met its match. I love the way the cream allows my face to feel upon application, but more so how quickly it has rejuvenated my skin.
Improving my skin tone. I have super sensitive skin - no issues using this product.
Easy to use, pleasant feel and no noticeable odor.Very nice product. I definitely notice an improvement overnight. I use it as part of my Strivectin retinol routine.
I've been using Strivectin since its launch. I'm now 82 and look in my 60ies. Thank you Strivectin. No surgery
Love the way it makes my skin feel. Also fine wrinkles are gone!

I have dry sensitive skin. I also have fine lines and deeper wrinkles. I am 85, my skin looks very good. I use the Advanced Retinol alternately with the Advance Hydration serum. My skin has fewer wrinkles and fine lines. I receive many compliments and inquiries about my skin. Advanced Retinol Cream is easy to apply and is fragrance free. I love this product!
I receive compliments on how smooth my skin is even though I am over 65 years of age. I love this product and like the StriVectin products and will continue to use them.
I have been using this product for a while now. I love the feel of it and have noticed improvement in texture of my skin. I have bought a few times now.
Since using the Advanced Retinol Serum nightly, my skin is smoother, my lines less pronounced and my pores and acne scars almost unnoticeable.
My new StriVectin product, works wonders with pores and skin appearance
I just started but it feels good on my skin and I have no sensitivity to it.
I feel is doing a great job only skin every night. my skin looks much better next day.
I have been using this for 8 weeks now and I can REALLY tell a difference on my forehead and my crows feet. I use this every night with the advanced retinol moisturizer and the STAR oil.
This serum goes on smoothly and works really well. So far I see an improvement in my complexion.

avis.titre: Strivectin products make an amazing difference on my skin
avis.texte: Strivectin retinol smooths and firms my skin and doesn't cause ANY irritation. Very worthwhile!
I noticed my wrinkles are much less noticeable after using this product for about 1 month.

avis.titre: I Must Have a Retinol Sensitivity
avis.texte: I've tried this product several times at night, and each time I awaken to find rough, dry patches. I have also had this effect from other products that contain retinol, so I suspect I simply have a sensitivity to that substance. It can take up to a week of pampering with other great Strivectin products before those patches heal and soften. Sad to have spent so much on something I can't use!

This product is great. I can use it everyday without irritation or dryness and it has definitely helped with my fine lines and generally just gives me a smoother, healthier complexion. I can tell a difference when I run out.
I got this as a bday sample from ulta to help with my smile lines and so far I've been seeing a bit of a difference just make sure to wash your face the morning after.
I was looking for a nightly retinol treatment to help maintain my facials. I think this helps prolong the results. The texture is nice - not hard to distribute on your skin.
Unfortunately no improvement to fine wrinkles after 4 months of nightly use. Would not buy again.
Such an effective product. I use every night with no irritation. I love the texture of the serum. Will continue to use.
After just 2 weeks I've noticed a difference. My 11s are less noticeable and my skin looks less dull and more even. If only it were cheaper!!!!

Around 3 months ago I decided to take the plunge and revamp my whole skincare system w/ Strivectin products. Along with the Anti-Wrinkle Wrinkle Recode, I also purchased the Anti-Wrinkle Intensive Eye Concentrate, Advanced Retinol Daily Repair Moisturizer w/ SPF, Advanced Retinol Nightly Serum, and the Advanced Retinol Nightly Moisturizer. A month later I added the STAR Light Retinol Night Oil and also the Super-C Retinol Serum. I was hoping to see improvements in retaining moisture, improving crepiness of skin, fine lines and wrinkles and lightening sun spots and dark spots from acne. So far I'd have to say I'm really happy with the products and believe I'm seeing improvements in most of the areas I wanted to correct. The serums are super emollient and even with layering all these different products I'm not experiencing any irritation or redness. My overall texture seems to have improved and any lingering crepiness is probably due to my habitual lack of not drinking enough water LOL. My most visible wrinkles are under my eyes and I think the deeper lines have improved somewhat and overall seems less noticeable than before. I am using both the day and night serums under and on my eyes prior to using the eye concentrate. I've also been using both serums on my neck and feel like the texture of the finer lines on my neck have improved but have yet to see anything really change with the deeper lines. I've always had issues w/ improving my hyperpigmentation so it's not surprising
This product has started working within a week. I've noticed a difference in my deep lines and texture already. Strivectin products never disappoint! Does not dry me out.
Best one I have used yet! Love it. It has improved the look of my face and neck. I'll definitely be buying again

Used this every night for about 6 weeks, and then it ran out. I didn't notice any positive differences on my face. I used it every night along with the moisturizer. I like my strivectin products, but this is not one I'd waste money on. It was expensive, did nothing, and didn't last long at all. Disappointed in this product.
I have always used retinol in my in skin care routine, but I absolutely love product! I saw results in two days!!! Love it!

I did not experience any skin irritation. Makes my skin texture smoother and more even. Even helps keep my skin clearer from blemishes. Sometimes I add a moisturizer afterwards as this is a serum and not a moisturizer. The fragrance is very light. It almost doesn't smell like it has any. I don't like strong fragrances, and this one did not bother me. I alternate this and the nightly moisturizer one. Together, I use them daily, alternating.
The results are amazing. I get a lot of compliments on my skin

I have been using this nightly since 9/2 on one side of my face. Today is 11/24 and I cannot observe one diminished line or pore in this 66 year old skin. Unles some miracle occurs between now and week 12, i officially question that 100% claim re fine lines. I'll finish the container and, if even an infinitesimal change occurs, i will review again. The 1 star is based on lack of desired result. Other than the complete failure in improving texture and lines, it's an inoffensive cream that doesn't produce irritation. I just wish it had done something for me.
Been using about 3 weeks now and notice a positive difference in the texture, pore size, fine lines & firmness. Has been gents yet effective.
What is the percentage of retinol in this product?..is it posted somewhere?
First retinol product that doesn't irritate my skin! Keeps all the promises. Very pleased!
I Purchased this for my 17-year-old grandson who is having problems with breaking out. He is using it nightly and we can really see the change so I would say my grandson loves it.
no difference noted; however, the formula is smooth and not too thick

A few positives are no redness or tightness from the retinol. Unfortunately my wrinkles are still the same with zero change since I've started. I love strivectin products and was hopeful with this - maybe with more time it'll get better. My skins texture is also the same.
Feels good, smells fine, helps with moisture and reduce wrinkles. Love the product and so far good results!

avis.titre: Have to give it more time
avis.texte: The jury is still out. My skin has been a bit dry and I'm not sure if it's from the retinol or the summer heat. Took some time off and just started using it again.
I absolutely love this serum in a week I can have added softness to my face and it looks like the scars are starting to fade
I only gave this product 3 stars because I like the way it made my skin feel, but it has a horrible scent that smells like a hot glue gun.

What a difference this product makes! Love all of StriVectin's products that keep me looking young. This serum does it's job of softening the deep wrinkles and keeping my face firm and supple. I use under the nightly renewal moisturizer.
I noticed a difference in fine lines after a few days. I was pleased with the results. I experienced continued results over the next few weeks! Deeper wrinkles softened and reduces.
I used this serum nightly and have had great results. Fewer wrinkles and very soft skin.

Impressed! I take skincare seriously and since turning 30 I've taken extra precautions! I've been really impressed with this serum. I have noticed improvements. It is definitely a night time serum. You will wake up greasy (to be expected) overall very impressed. I use it in combination with the night time lotion!

Skincare is really important to me. Since turning 30 I've tried to take extra precautions to prevent wrinkles/UV damage. I've been using this serum consistently for a month and I can definitely see a difference. It is definitely a night cream, you will wake up a little greasy (to be expected) I'm impressed!

I usually do not write reviews but this retinol skin serum is the best I've used! It's lightweight on my skin and absorbs well. It leaves my skin moisturized and glowing! I also use the retinol eye cream and the retinol night moisturizer. This combination is literally the best! My skin is firm and radiant! I love it! Highly recommend!
Absolutely love this product. I was getting compliments on my complexion with just 2 weeks of use.
Love this product. I have not experienced any irritation. Has evened out my skin tone and makes my skin glow.

I have not used this retinol product as I had more then I thought of the retinol night moisturizer that I had been using. But I expect it to be as good and affective as the other Strivectin products that I have been using.
Amazing! Definitely saw an immediate difference in my skin. Favorite product!
It went on well, nice smell expecting a little more lifting properties
This product is excellent. I have used it nightly after cleaning my face and see a difference in my skin after 3 weeks. It truly is Advanced Retinol and has worked magic.

I am 57 years old with a history of dry, sensitive, and sun damaged skin with deep forehead lines. I have used the Strivectin line of products exclusively for over three years. It has taken some time, but I have seen a dramatic improvement in my skin's overall appearance with daily use. I have avoided using any retinol products due to a history of blistering and peeling from another brand several years ago. I purchased this new Strivectin retinol product hoping that it would help to clear multiple large light pink scars on my forehead from a recent bout of shingles that occurred three months ago. All I can say is WOW! I have only been using this product for a week and it is already helping to fade the scars, and it is also dramatically helping with my deep forehead lines. I cannot wait to see what the future results will be with continued use.
